title: 'No one's coming to save us': Nick Sirianni faces questions about Eagles' effort, potential roster losses as NFL trade deadline nears

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 'No one's coming to save us': Nick Sirianni faces questions about Eagles' effort, potential roster losses as NFL trade deadline nears
sources.description: GM Howie Roseman has long been known to listen for sharp deals. Now, for the first time in years, Philadelphia may not have to risk a playoff run to test the market for players like Saquon Barkley.
